S=/private/tmp/claude-504/-Volumes-DAL-Zettelkasten-LLMeon/6ec7f455-1226-4359-9d78-eb0b9eaf2509/scratchpad
python3 - "$S" <<'EOF' > $S/typeplan.tsv
import re,sys
S=sys.argv[1]
skip={"Inner Strength & Resilience Skills (Your Strong Spirit)","The Emotional Cost of Being Wrong is Magnified by Loss Aversion"}
for l in open(S+'/moved_dest.txt'):
    p=l.strip()
    try:t=open(p,encoding='utf-8').read(3000)
    except: continue
    m=re.match(r'---\n(.*?)\n---',t,re.S)
    if not m:

    else:
        mm=re.search(r'^type:\s*(.+)$',m.group(1),re.M)

    if name=="SoT - Recursive Language Models" and ty=="note": print(f"sot\t{p}")
    elif ty in (None,'MoC','MOC'): print(f"map\t{p}")
EOF

cmd:
S=/private/tmp/claude-504/-Volumes-DAL-Zettelkasten-LLMeon/6ec7f455-1226-4359-9d78-eb0b9eaf2509/scratchpad

echo "== body changes across all 50 (lines changed outside frontmatter) =="
python3 - "$S" <<'EOF'
import subprocess,sys,re
n=0
for l in open(sys.argv[1]+'/typeplan.tsv'):
    val,p=l.rstrip('\n').split('\t')
    name=p.split('/')[-1]
    for d in ('MoC','SoT'):
        r=subprocess.run(['git','show',f'HEAD:30_Library/{d}/{name}'],capture_output=True,text=True)

    new=open(p,encoding='utf-8').read()

    if body(old)!=body(new): n+=1; print("BODY CHANGED:",name)
print("body-changed:",n)
EOF
